subject: Benchmark onboarding requirements and measurement spec - next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Benchmark onboarding requirements and measurement spec - next steps

Hi Tom / Sally —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the performance qualification scheduled: 

Ask / target (please confirm):
- Primary SLO: P95 first-byte latency for streamed responses <= 150ms (user-visible streaming start).
- End-to-end P95 (full-response) <= 350ms for single-turn queries at typical prompt length (see prompt set).
- Sustained throughput target: 300 requests/min across 80 concurrent connections.
- Concurrency breakdown: 60 low-latency interactive sessions + 20 high-throughput batch sessions.
- Streaming requirement: chunked partial outputs with max inter-chunk latency <= 50ms; must support server-sent events (SSE) or chunked HTTP.

What I’m attaching: redwood_benchmark_template.json (harness template) and an initial measurement_spec_v1.pdf that defines the metrics we will report (p50/p95/p99, mean token throughput, per-token CPU/GPU utilization hooks).

Please: 1) confirm the targets above or flag changes, 2) share a sandbox API key (time-limited) or let me know if you prefer us to run on a dedicated instance, and 3) indicate a 48-hour window next week for the run.

If you want changes to the prompt set, attach your sample prompts and we’ll incorporate them into the harness.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Benchmark onboarding requirements and measurement spec - next steps

Thanks Neha — high level looks good. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Streaming/start-of-response: we care most about perceived latency for chat use-cases. Can you measure both time-to-first-chunk and time-to-first-token (if you separate those)? Our internal goal is time-to-first-token p95 <= 200ms; if you can report both metrics that would be ideal.
2) End-to-end: we can relax to p95 <= 400ms for the longer prompts (we have a mix of short/long). For our baseline run, use the mix in attached prompt set (shopwise_sampling_prompts_v0.3.json).
3) Throughput/concurrency: we need to validate 300 req/min sustained but can start the first run at 200 req/min to get a warm cache. Please include a warm-up phase.
4) Security/compliance: procurement asked for the SOC2 questionnaire and a short note on how audit logs are exported during benchmark runs — I’ll loop procurement once we lock timing.

Sandbox: yes, please use the sandbox endpoint. I will produce a time-limited key for Redwood engineering (will send separately to the sandbox address you provide).

Attached: shopwise_sampling_prompts_v0.3.json (sample prompts), small config file listing our tokenization settings.

—Tom

FW: forwarding ShopWise confirmation and prompt set. Monica / Rishi / Dev — can you review feasibility and confirm approach? Important asks:
- Streamed first-token p95 <= 200ms (ShopWise target) + p95 streamed chunk inter-arrival <= 50ms.
- Baseline warm-up at 200 req/min, target run at 300 req/min across ~80 concurrent connections.
- Need to run in sandbox; ShopWise will provide a time-limited key.

Questions for engineering:
1) Can we reproduce SSE/chunk behaviors reliably on Hosted Sandbox or do we need a Dedicated instance to hit concurrency SLOs?
2) Measurement hooks: can we export per-token server-side timestamps and a transcript of chunk boundaries? Will that conflict with PII constraints for the customer?
3) Do we have a recommended quantization profile or kernel toggles for this model class to reach the target output rate while preserving latency?

Please respond with a quick feasibility note + the earliest 48-hour window you can run the harness. I’ve attached the ShopWise prompt set and our template harness.

Thanks —
Neha

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: FW: Benchmark onboarding requirements and measurement spec - next steps

Thanks Neha — quick feasibility / plan below. I’ll own the harness run and reporting; Dev + Rishi please take the action items.

Feasibility summary:
- Hosted Sandbox: feasible for functional streaming tests and first-token latency metrics up to ~50 concurrent sessions. For the full 80-concurrency/300 req/min sustained run we recommend a short-lived Dedicated instance (2x A100 equivalent) to avoid noisy neighbor variance and to meet the concurrency SLO reproducibly. We can still run the warm-up on Hosted Sandbox.
- Measurement hooks: we can emit per-token server-side timestamps and chunk boundary events into the benchmark trace. Those traces will be scrubbed for PII (we will only store token-level timing and hashes, not raw prompt contents) — meets typical procurement asks.
- Quantization/kernel profile: suggest running with fp16 kernels first; if GPU pressure requires it we’ll test 4-bit quantized variant (q4_KV) and report quality deltas.

Proposed run plan (high level):
1) Day 0 (pre-run): ingest shopwise_sampling_prompts_v0.3.json, validate tokenization parity, seed model weights/config. Deliverable: "measurement_spec_v1.pdf" and small change list to prompts.
2) Day 1: Hosted Sandbox warm-up (200 req/min for 45 minutes); collect traces, compute p50/p95/p99.
3) Day 2: Dedicated run (300 req/min sustained, 80 concurrency); collect full traces and GPU telemetry.
4) Post-run (within 24h): deliver a results summary, SLO pass/fail matrix, and suggestions (batching/cache/quantization) to reach target economics.

Action items (owners):
- Dev Patel: prepare sandbox endpoint and accept ShopWise time-limited key. Add SSE support hooks to the harness (due EOD today).
- Rishi Malhotra: create the Dedicated instance template and a short automation playbook to spin it up/tear down for the 48h window.
- Monica Patel (me): prepare measurement_spec_v1.pdf, update the harness template, and run the tests.

Scheduling: we can be ready to begin the warm-up as early as Mon, Nov 16 if ShopWise can provide the key by EOD Fri Nov 13. Otherwise push one week.

Attachments: measurement_spec_v1.pdf, sandbox_harness_notes.md

Monica Patel
